title: Turing machine configuration row
statement: For a finite-state Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and natural numbers $n$ and $s$, a configuration row consists of an $n$-bit input, an optional state of $M$, an input-head position among $n+2$ positions, a Boolean-or-blank symbol for each work tape at each of $2s+1$ cells, a head position among those cells for each work tape, and an output summary.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
